areas.t: Saturday, November 14 is a Wood Stove Curtailment Day. Wood stove burning is prohibited unless you are burning seasoned wood in a registered EPA-compliant wood stove with phase two emissions control technology or better.  For more information on registering your wood heating device please contact NS
